nameOrigin: the letter ‘z’, often used to denote sleep

pokedexEntries.rb: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

pokedexEntries.ye: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it has eaten in the past.

pokedexEntries.go: If you think that you had a good dream, but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.

pokedexEntries.si: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

pokedexEntries.cr: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

pokedexEntries.rs: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these POKéMON is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

pokedexEntries.fr: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

pokedexEntries.lg: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

pokedexEntries.em: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

pokedexEntries.hg: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.

pokedexEntries.ss: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

pokedexEntries.bw: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

pokedexEntries.x: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

pokedexEntries.y: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

pokedexEntries.oras: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

pokedexEntries.su: A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.

pokedexEntries.mo: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it’s ever eaten.

pokedexEntries.us: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

pokedexEntries.um: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn’t particularly like eating them.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
